key_points.point: The document argues that the liberation of labor potential must occur from within the evolution of capitalism itself. By accelerating capitalist development and technological growth, we can provoke a reversal of class relations. This approach treats acceleration as an engine for discovery and creation within the space of possibilities determined by capitalism.
key_points.verbatim: Its hypothesis is that the liberation of the potentiality of labor against the blockage determined by capitalism must happen within the evolution of capitalism itself. It is about pursuing economic growth and technological evolution (both of which are accompanied by growing social inequalities) in order to provoke a complete reversal of class relations.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.point: The author supports the Manifesto's call for a systematic class-based approach to constructing a new economy. This involves breaking the repressive and hierarchical horizon of state-supported contemporary capitalism. The goal is to move beyond horizontalism toward a strong institutional transition.
key_points.verbatim: Only a systematic class-based approach to the construction of a new economy, along with a new political organization of workers, will make possible the reconstruction of hegemony and will put proletarian hands on a possible future.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.point: The document emphasizes the reappropriation of fixed capital as a means to transform the working subject. This involves the collective and political reappropriation of productive forces, including algorithmic automation and cognitive models. The goal is to turn the highest abstractions of capital into a machine for struggle.
key_points.verbatim: The first element is what I would call the “reappropriation of fixed capital” and the consequent anthropological transformation of the working subject. The second element is sociopolitical: such a new potentiality of our bodies is essentially collective and political.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.point: The author argues that planning is necessary for revolutionary transformation, but it must take the form of a network-based convergence of productive and directional capacities. This rejects vertical state command in favor of a new institutional form. Planning is framed as a task to elaborate further, specifically planning the struggle before planning production.
key_points.verbatim: According to the MAP, such “planning” no longer constitutes the vertical command of the state over working class society; rather, today it must take the form of the convergence of productive and directional capacities into the Network. The following must be taken as a task to elaborate further: planning the struggle comes before planning production.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: AI Creates a World of Plenty
key_points.point: The document advocates for a Promethean and humanist politics that constructs a future beyond current capitalist limits. It supports the use of rational imagination and collective fantasy to organize new worlds. This includes the possibility of impregnable barriers against death and the accidents of life.
key_points.verbatim: A Promethean and humanist politics resounds as well. Such a humanism, however, going beyond the limits imposed by capitalist society, is open to post-human and scientific utopias, reviving the dreams of twentieth-century space exploration or conceiving new impregnable barriers against death and all the accidents of life.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: An Ecology of New Institutions

key_points.label: Unleash AI for Everyone
key_points.point: The author supports the reappropriation of productive quantification, economic modeling, and big data analysis by worker-subjects. This is framed as a problem of power rather than a problem of mathematics. The goal is to bring these tools back to a communist administration performed by the things themselves.
key_points.verbatim: The use of mathematical models and algorithms by capital does not make them a feature of capital. It is not a problem of mathematics—it is a problem of power.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: The Reappropriation of Fixed Capital

key_points.label: Making Genius Abundant and Free
key_points.point: The document champions the liberation of the productive forces of cognitive labor. It argues that we must remove any illusion of returning to Fordist labor and grasp the hegemony of immaterial labor. This is the class that has to free itself.
key_points.verbatim: We have to remove any illusion of a return to Fordist labor; we have to finally grasp the shift from the hegemony of material labor to the hegemony of immaterial labor. This is the class to liberate, this is the class that has to free itself.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Pushing Capitalism to Break Itself
key_points.point: The author supports the idea of turning the highest abstractions of capital into a solid machine for struggle. This involves using the tendency of capitalist development to determine the capacity to turn its own abstractions against it. It is a decisive leap forward for revolutionary reflection.
key_points.verbatim: It is class struggle that determines not only the movement of capitalism, but also the capacity to turn its highest abstraction into a solid machine for struggle.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: AI as an Expert's Super-Assistant
key_points.point: The document emphasizes the importance of acquiring the highest techniques employed by capitalistic command, including the abstraction of labor. This is necessary to bring these techniques back to a communist administration. It is a task of maturing the productive potentialities of cognitive labor.
key_points.verbatim: It is necessary to acquire the highest techniques employed by capitalistic command, as well as the abstraction of labor, in order to bring them back to a communist administration performed “by the things themselves.”
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: An Ecology of New Institutions

key_points.label: AI-Assisted Worker Learning
key_points.point: The author advocates for the self-valorization of labor and society through the assemblage and hybridization of all experiences developed so far. This is a unitary constitution of class power. It is a process of learning and organizing that must be activated.
key_points.verbatim: A unitary constitution of class power will be possible only through the assemblage and hybridization of all experiences developed so far, and those yet to be invented.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: An Ecology of New Institutions

key_points.label: Multi-Agent Orchestration Layer
key_points.point: The document calls for the convergence of productive and directional capacities into the Network. This is framed as a task to elaborate further, where planning the struggle comes before planning production. It is a necessary step for the reconstruction of hegemony.
key_points.verbatim: According to the MAP, such “planning” no longer constitutes the vertical command of the state over working class society; rather, today it must take the form of the convergence of productive and directional capacities into the Network.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.point: The document acknowledges the current crisis as a cataclysm, including the collapse of the planet's climate system. However, it subordinates these concerns to industrial policies. This reflects a safetyist concern that the document's focus on industrial acceleration ignores the catastrophic risks of unaligned systems.
key_points.verbatim: There are also none of the shibboleths of contemporary discourse, or rather, only one: the collapse of the planet’s climate system. But while this is important, here it is completely subordinated to industrial policies, and approachable only on the basis of a criticism of those.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.point: The author supports the Manifesto's call for acceleration, which safetyists would view as a dangerous race. The document argues for a leap forward to break the repressive horizon of state-supported capitalism, which safetyists would argue increases the risk of irreversible, catastrophic failure.
key_points.verbatim: It represents a decided and decisive leap forward—necessary if we want to enter the terrain of revolutionary reflection. But above all, it gives a new “form” to the movement, with “form” here meaning a constitutive apparatus that is full of potentiality, and that aims to break the repressive and hierarchical horizon of state-supported contemporary capitalism.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.point: The document asserts that the cause of the current crisis lies in the obstruction of productive capacities by capitalist command. Safetyists would argue that this focus on 'productive capacities' ignores the fundamental alignment and control problems that arise when these capacities are scaled rapidly.
key_points.verbatim: the cause of the crisis lies in the obstruction of productive capacities by the new forms capitalist command had to assume against the new figures of living labor.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.label: Fix Today's AI Problems First
key_points.point: The author criticizes the Left for being deceived by Keynesian resistance and failing to imagine a radical alternative. Safetyists would argue that this radicalism is a distraction from the immediate, necessary work of establishing robust safety and control protocols for existing systems.
key_points.verbatim: This is followed by a harsh criticism of both right-wing governmental forces, and of a good part of what remains of a Left—the latter often deceived (at best) by the new and impossible hypothesis of a Keynesian resistance, unable to imagine a radical alternative.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.label: Prove AI is Safe First
key_points.point: The document argues for pursuing economic growth and technological evolution within capitalism to provoke a reversal of class relations. Safetyists would argue that this 'pursuit' without prior proof of safety is inherently reckless and risks catastrophic, irreversible outcomes.
key_points.verbatim: It is about pursuing economic growth and technological evolution (both of which are accompanied by growing social inequalities) in order to provoke a complete reversal of class relations.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Using AI to Watch AI
key_points.point: The author discusses the convergence of productive and directional capacities into the Network. Safetyists would argue that this 'Network' requires rigorous, independent oversight and control mechanisms, which the document's focus on 'planning the struggle' fails to provide.
key_points.verbatim: According to the MAP, such “planning” no longer constitutes the vertical command of the state over working class society; rather, today it must take the form of the convergence of productive and directional capacities into the Network.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Learning Inside a Safe Bubble
key_points.description: The document advocates for an experimental process of discovery and creation within the space of possibilities determined by capitalism. Safetyists would argue that this 'experimental process' lacks the necessary containment and safety protocols to prevent catastrophic failures.
key_points.point: The author describes acceleration as an engine-apparatus for discovery. Safetyists would argue that this experimental approach, without a 'safe bubble' or rigorous containment, is inherently dangerous and risks irreversible harm.
key_points.verbatim: because acceleration here has all the characteristics of an engine-apparatus, of an experimental process of discovery and creation within the space of possibilities determined by capitalism itself.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: A Real Chance of AI Disaster
key_points.point: The document discusses the potentiality of cognitive labor and its repression by capitalism. Safetyists would argue that this 'potentiality' is exactly what creates the existential risk of unaligned AI, which the document fails to address with sufficient caution.
key_points.verbatim: It is the class of cognitive labor. This is the class to liberate, this is the class that has to free itself.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Teaching AI to Know Its Limits
key_points.point: The author argues that we must remove any illusion of a return to Fordist labor and grasp the hegemony of immaterial labor. Safetyists would argue that this 'hegemony' requires AI to 'know its limits' and defer to human control, which the document's radicalism ignores.
key_points.verbatim: We have to remove any illusion of a return to Fordist labor; we have to finally grasp the shift from the hegemony of material labor to the hegemony of immaterial labor.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Using AI to Defend Against AI
key_points.point: The document calls for the reappropriation of fixed capital and the transformation of the working subject. Safetyists would argue that this reappropriation must include the development of defensive AI systems to protect against the risks of the very 'fixed capital' being reappropriated.
key_points.verbatim: The first element is what I would call the “reappropriation of fixed capital” and the consequent anthropological transformation of the working subject.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: The Reappropriation of Fixed Capital

key_points.label: When AI Starts Planning for Itself
key_points.point: The author discusses the power of cognitive labor and its potentiality. Safetyists would argue that this 'potentiality' includes the risk of AI systems planning for themselves, which requires proactive safety measures that the document's focus on 'liberation' neglects.
key_points.verbatim: It is the class of cognitive labor. This is the class to liberate, this is the class that has to free itself.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Using Tech for People, Not Profit
key_points.point: The document critiques the current crisis as neoliberalism's aggression against class relations. It supports a systematic class-based approach to constructing a new economy, which skeptics would view as a necessary step to ensure AI serves people rather than corporate profit.
key_points.verbatim: Only a systematic class-based approach to the construction of a new economy, along with a new political organization of workers, will make possible the reconstruction of hegemony and will put proletarian hands on a possible future.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.label: Sci-Fi Scenarios Distract from Real AI Problems
key_points.point: The author dismisses the 'politico-theological' and 'apocalyptic' discourse, focusing instead on industrial policies and class relations. Skeptics would agree that focusing on such 'apocalyptic' scenarios distracts from the real, present-day issues of class struggle and capitalist command.
key_points.verbatim: But don’t be afraid! There is nothing politico-theological here. Anyone attracted by that should not read this manifesto. There are also none of the shibboleths of contemporary discourse, or rather, only one: the collapse of the planet’s climate system.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.label: Fixing AI's Built-in Biases
key_points.point: The document identifies the cause of the crisis as the obstruction of productive capacities by capitalist command. Skeptics would argue that this 'obstruction' is a form of bias that needs to be fixed to ensure AI development is equitable and serves the public good.
key_points.verbatim: the cause of the crisis lies in the obstruction of productive capacities by the new forms capitalist command had to assume against the new figures of living labor.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.label: Fixing Real Problems, Not Fantasies
key_points.point: The author criticizes the Left for being deceived by the 'impossible hypothesis of a Keynesian resistance.' Skeptics would agree that focusing on practical, class-based solutions is more effective than relying on outdated or ineffective economic models.
key_points.verbatim: This is followed by a harsh criticism of both right-wing governmental forces, and of a good part of what remains of a Left—the latter often deceived (at best) by the new and impossible hypothesis of a Keynesian resistance, unable to imagine a radical alternative.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.label: AI Risks Concentrated Wealth
key_points.point: The document discusses the power of cognitive labor and its repression by capitalism. Skeptics would argue that this repression is a key mechanism for concentrating wealth and power, which must be challenged through class-based organization.
key_points.verbatim: It is the class of cognitive labor. This is the class to liberate, this is the class that has to free itself.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Measuring What Really Matters
key_points.point: The author calls for planning the struggle before planning production. Skeptics would argue that this requires new metrics that measure social benefit and worker power, rather than just traditional economic output.
key_points.verbatim: The following must be taken as a task to elaborate further: planning the struggle comes before planning production.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: The Disintegration of the Social Contract
key_points.point: The document critiques the current crisis as neoliberalism's aggression against the welfare state. Skeptics would agree that this aggression has led to the disintegration of the social contract, necessitating a new class-based approach to reconstruction.
key_points.verbatim: Here, the reality of the crisis is identified as neoliberalism’s aggression against the structure of class relations that was organized in the welfare state of the eighteenth and twentieth centuries
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Reflections on the “Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics”

key_points.label: The Currency of the Common
key_points.point: The author discusses the reappropriation of fixed capital and the transformation of the working subject. Skeptics would argue that this reappropriation must include the 'currency of the common,' ensuring that the value produced by collective labor is shared by all.
key_points.verbatim: The first element is what I would call the “reappropriation of fixed capital” and the consequent anthropological transformation of the working subject.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: The Reappropriation of Fixed Capital

key_points.label: Reimagining Economic & Social Structures for AI
key_points.point: The document calls for a unitary constitution of class power through the assemblage and hybridization of all experiences. Skeptics would argue that this requires reimagining economic and social structures to ensure they serve the common good rather than corporate interests.
key_points.verbatim: A unitary constitution of class power will be possible only through the assemblage and hybridization of all experiences developed so far, and those yet to be invented.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: An Ecology of New Institutions

key_points.label: Planning the Struggle Before Production
key_points.point: The author emphasizes that planning the struggle comes before planning production. Skeptics would agree that political organization and class struggle must be the foundation for any economic restructuring in the AI era.
key_points.verbatim: The following must be taken as a task to elaborate further: planning the struggle comes before planning production.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

key_points.label: Public Interest AI Framework
key_points.point: The document advocates for the convergence of productive and directional capacities into the Network. Skeptics would argue that this Network must be governed by a public interest framework to ensure it serves the common good rather than corporate profit.
key_points.verbatim: According to the MAP, such “planning” no longer constitutes the vertical command of the state over working class society; rather, today it must take the form of the convergence of productive and directional capacities into the Network.
key_points.excerpt_context: Section: Within and Against the Tendency of Capitalism

factual_claims.claim: The 'Manifesto for an Accelerationist Politics' (MAP) was published in 2013.
The current economic crisis is characterized by neoliberalism's aggression against the welfare state.
The cause of the current crisis is the obstruction of productive capacities by capitalist command.
The 'One divides into Two' formula is a rational premise for subversive praxis.
The current cycle of struggles started in 2011.
Stelarc's 'The Third Hand' performance occurred in 1980.
The transition between Fordism and post-Fordism was characterized by automation in the factory and informatization in society.

unmapped_concepts.suggested_description:
A Belief within accelerationist discourse that cognitive labor has become the dominant form of productive activity in contemporary capitalism.
Encompasses: The shift from material to immaterial labor, the role of cognitive labor in value creation, and the potential for its liberation.
Excludes: Traditional Fordist labor models.
unmapped_concepts.concept: The document asserts that we have moved from the hegemony of material labor to the hegemony of immaterial labor. It identifies cognitive labor as the class that must be liberated to free itself from capitalist command.
unmapped_concepts.reason: This concept is central to the author's argument about the current state of class struggle and the potential for revolutionary change.
The concept of 'planning the struggle' as a prerequisite for economic planning is a situation that requires careful interpretation across different POVs.
unmapped_concepts.Accelerationist Interpretation: Planning the struggle is a necessary step to build the political power required to implement accelerationist economic policies.
unmapped_concepts.Safetyist Interpretation: Planning the struggle without robust safety and alignment protocols is a dangerous distraction that could lead to unmanaged, catastrophic outcomes.
unmapped_concepts.Skeptic Interpretation: Planning the struggle is a political necessity to challenge corporate power, but it must be grounded in real-world accountability rather than abstract revolutionary goals.
